## Brand & Style

The design system projects absolute reliability, analytical precision, and developer-first velocity. Built for quality engineers, SDETs, and technical leads, the aesthetic embodies modern technical rigor: quiet structural confidence punctuated by vibrant, high-signal status indicators. It blends the calm efficiency of modern developer tooling with the structured clarity of enterprise mission control.

The visual style unites **Corporate / Modern** discipline with **Low-Contrast Structural Outlines**. It rejects ornamental skeuomorphism and excessive blur in favor of pixel-perfect 1px borders, subtle surface elevations, tight data density, and instantaneous readability across dense test suites, automated CI pipelines, and real-time execution graphs.

## Colors

The foundation is built on deep slate and obsidian neutrals (`#0F172A`, `#1E293B`, `#334155`), ensuring prolonged visual comfort during continuous monitoring and deep-dive triage sessions. 

Signal tokens communicate execution states with zero ambiguity:
- **Primary (`#3B82F6`)**: Active test execution, focused filters, primary triggers, and core navigation indicators.
- **Success / Passed (`#10B981`)**: Passed test suites, resolved incidents, healthy coverage targets, and high build confidence.
- **Warning / Flaky (`#F59E0B`)**: Flaky tests, degraded execution times, retries, and moderate priority alerts.
- **Destructive / Failed (`#EF4444`)**: Fatal build failures, assertion breaks, regression alerts, and critical blocking defects.
- **Specialized / Functional (`#8B5CF6`)**: End-to-end and functional automation tracks, synthetic workflows, and scheduled cron jobs.

Sub-surface contrast utilizes `#1E293B` for card containers and elevated panels, bordered by `#334155` at 60% opacity to preserve crisp structural partitions without clutter.

## Typography

The typographic hierarchy couples high-legibility geometric UI grotesque (`Geist`, `Inter`) with technical monospaced precision (`JetBrains Mono`). 

Headings rely on `Geist` with optical negative letter-spacing for tight, architectural titles. Running content and metric descriptions utilize `Inter` to sustain clarity across high-density tables and log traces. Numerical test results, durations, assertion counts, timestamps, commit hashes, and stack traces strictly utilize `JetBrains Mono` for tabular alignment and rapid scanning.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model employs a responsive 12-column fluid grid paired with fixed developer-centric utility sidebars (64px collapsed, 240px expanded). The grid accommodates high-density dashboard layouts: 4-column micro-metric strips, 8/4 split execution breakdowns, and full-width multi-tab telemetry consoles.

Breakpoints are defined as:
- **Desktop (>= 1280px)**: 12-column grid, `gutter-lg` (24px), persistent dual navigation, dense telemetry views.
- **Tablet (768px - 1279px)**: 8-column grid, `gutter` (16px), collapsible rail navigation, stacked metrics cards.
- **Mobile (< 768px)**: 4-column grid, `margin-mobile` (16px), off-canvas execution controls, scrollable tabular views with sticky key columns.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual separation relies primarily on tonal zoning and crisp hairline boundaries rather than dramatic drop shadows.

- **Base Layer (Canvas)**: `#0F172A`, the foundational context.
- **Surface Layer 1 (Containers & Panels)**: `#1E293B`, bound by 1px stroke `rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12)`.
- **Surface Layer 2 (Hover states & Active rows)**: `#334155` at 50% opacity, providing immediate tactile response without structural displacement.
- **Overlay & Popovers (Flyouts, Command Palettes, Modals)**: Surface fill `#1E293B` bordered by `rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.24)` with an ambient shadow: `0 8px 24px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)`.
- **Status Glows**: Active executing jobs and critical break points emit an ultra-diffused 4px radial glow keyed to their respective semantic accent color at 20% opacity.

## Shapes

The design system adopts a refined, technical contour (`roundedness: 1`). Interactive elements, inputs, metric tiles, and standard cards employ a 4px base corner radius (`rounded-sm`). Floating modals, popovers, and elevated test panels step up to 8px (`rounded-lg`). Status chips, duration indicators, and runtime tags adopt fully pill-shaped radii only when conveying continuous state or categorical classification.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action (Run Tests, Re-run Suite)**: Solid `#3B82F6` fill with high-contrast white text, 4px border radius, medium font weight. Subtle brightened hover state (`#60A5FA`).
- **Secondary / Ghost (Filter, Export, Logs)**: Transparent surface, 1px border `rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2)`, text `#F8FAFC`. Active state triggers `#1E293B`.
- **Destructive (Abort Execution, Purge Cache)**: Transparent background with `#EF4444` border and text; fills on deliberate intent.

### Status Badges & Chips
- Semantically tinted background (12% opacity) paired with solid accent borders (30% opacity) and high-luminance foreground text.
- Formats include: `PASSED` (Emerald), `FAILED` (Crimson), `FLAKY` (Amber), `RUNNING` (Electric Blue with animated pulse dot), and `E2E/API` (Violet).
- Fixed-height micro variant (20px) featuring `JetBrains Mono` 11px uppercase type.

### Micro-Metric Cards
- Compact 120px–140px fixed-height modules containing: metric title in uppercase `body-sm` neutral slate, large numeric readout (`headline-lg` in `JetBrains Mono`), delta indicator (+/- %), and a bottom-aligned 2px sparkline or execution duration graph.

### Form Inputs & Filters
- Inverted surfaces (`#0F172A`) inset into `#1E293B` containers.
- 1px hairline border in `#334155`, transitioning to `#3B82F6` with a zero-offset 1px ring on active focus.
- Search inputs embed quick-key indicators (`⌘K`) aligned right.

### Tables & Log Traces
- Borderless interior cell divisions relying on alternating row treatments and sticky column headers.
- Stack trace drawers embed dark-code viewports with line numbers, highlighted failure frames, and instant copy-to-clipboard actions.
